matters.name: Northstar Analytics - SaaS Vendor Review
matters.description: A customer-side SaaS renewal with AI-training, security, and liability issues.
matters.demo_prompt: Review the MSA and data addendum for customer-side risks, cite the source clauses, and propose follow-up tasks for the renewal and data-use issues.
suggested_tasks: Negotiate AI training and de-identification restriction
Propose a 12-month fee cap and calendar the renewal notice
Add security/privacy liability carve-out and balanced indemnity

matters.name: HarborLight Robotics - Series Seed Financing
matters.description: A founder-friendly seed financing with approvals, cap-table, and closing work.
matters.demo_prompt: Compare the term sheet to the board consent, identify missing approvals and closing conditions, and prepare a prioritized closing checklist.
suggested_tasks: Verify charter/bylaw approval thresholds and director conflicts
Prepare stockholder consent and charter filing package
Reconcile option pool and capitalization certificate
Collect invention assignments and key-person agreements

matters.name: Redwood Outdoor Supply - Outside General Counsel Retainer
matters.description: A lively monthly outside-counsel portfolio with contract, product, and governance work.
matters.demo_prompt: Triage the August legal requests, show the next notice deadlines, and draft the monthly retainer portfolio summary with decisions needed.
suggested_tasks: Review PinePeak exclusivity and forecast remedies
Calendar Evergreen Packaging non-renewal notice
Review warehouse pilot data and security terms
Prepare September board-materials legal section

matters.name: Sunbeam Drone - Rooftop Delivery Demand
matters.description: A fictional rooftop delivery pilot ended with a damaged greenhouse, a viral video, and a demand letter that arrives before the insurer has finished its factual review.
matters.demo_prompt: Build a claim chronology, identify the preservation steps, and draft a measured response that does not concede the disputed marketing statement.
suggested_tasks: Issue legal hold and preserve flight, marketing, and support records
Map contract, insurance, and agency-notice deadlines
Prepare demand-response chronology and settlement authority memo

matters.name: Pineapple Fitness - Member Data Request
matters.description: A former spin-class regular asks what the studio knows about her while a well-meaning manager has already offered to send a spreadsheet from the front-desk system.
matters.demo_prompt: Create a practical DSAR plan, flag the data that needs human review, and prepare the questions for the booking and marketing vendors.
suggested_tasks: Open verified request record and freeze automatic deletion
Collect booking, payment, and marketing-vendor data maps
Draft access, deletion, and partner-disclosure response package

matters.name: Brew & Bloom - Store Manager Separation
matters.description: A popular store manager is accused of changing tip allocations, but the complaint lands two days after she raised scheduling concerns in a staff group chat.
matters.demo_prompt: Build an investigation plan that tests the tip allegation and the retaliation risk, then prepare an HR decision checklist.
suggested_tasks: Preserve POS, payroll, schedule, and group-chat records
Prepare witness interview plan and comparator review
Draft separation-or-coaching checklist with final-pay steps

matters.name: TrailTrack - Kids Adventure Watch Launch
matters.description: The product team wants a fun September launch for a kids' hiking watch with location sharing, parent challenges, and a battery claim that marketing describes as 'weekend-proof.'
matters.demo_prompt: Turn this launch brief into a prioritized product legal checklist, with specific edits to the battery and location-sharing claims.
suggested_tasks: Review launch claims against test evidence and product behavior
Draft parent-facing location and trial disclosures
Create retailer FAQ and launch-risk signoff checklist

matters.name: Moonbeam Bakery - Sparkle Crumb Brand Clash
matters.description: A neighborhood bakery plans a 'Sparkle Crumb' sprinkle-kit launch, then receives a friendly but firm message from a regional cookie company using a similar name on social media.
matters.demo_prompt: Create a brand-risk matrix and a practical next-step plan for the founder before the holiday packaging deadline.
suggested_tasks: Build trademark clearance and usage evidence checklist
Inventory packaging, web, and social uses of the proposed mark
Draft non-admission response and holiday-print decision memo

matters.name: Pearl & Pixel - AI Recruiter Pilot
matters.description: A design studio wants to use an AI tool to sort portfolio submissions before its seasonal hiring sprint, while the vendor promises that its 'bias-free' scoring is ready on day one.
matters.demo_prompt: Assess this AI hiring pilot, identify the controls needed before launch, and draft a concise go/no-go recommendation.
suggested_tasks: Create AI use-case inventory and human-oversight record
Negotiate pilot data-use and model-change controls
Draft candidate notice and recruiter training checklist

matters.name: FreshNest - Sleepy Tea Label Refresh
matters.description: A tea company wants to make its calming blend feel more magical for a grocery reset, but the draft label moves from 'bedtime ritual' toward claims that sound like treatment.
matters.demo_prompt: Classify the proposed claims, suggest safer alternatives, and build a ten-day approval plan for the label refresh.
suggested_tasks: Redline label and campaign claims by support level
Create testimonial, influencer, and moderation guidance
Prepare retailer deadline plan and approval archive

matters.name: Riverstone - School-Year Parenting Plan
matters.description: Two parents agree that their daughter loves robotics club and her rescue rabbit, but they need a workable school-year schedule before a job transfer changes the weekday routine.
matters.demo_prompt: Turn these facts into a neutral mediation agenda and a child-centered parenting-plan checklist without giving jurisdiction-specific legal advice.
suggested_tasks: Build parenting-time calendar and holiday options
Prepare mediation issue list and communication protocol
Collect school, activity, travel, and expense information

matters.name: Parker - Summer Festival Citation
matters.description: A summer festival ends with a citation, a lost phone, and two different accounts of whether a barricade was visible in the crowd.
matters.demo_prompt: Build an initial defense-case checklist that prioritizes evidence preservation, court preparation, and client communications.
suggested_tasks: Preserve venue, phone, and witness evidence
Create citation timeline and discovery request checklist
Prepare client communication and first-appearance checklist

matters.name: Lakeside Bakery - First Brick-and-Mortar Lease
matters.description: A bakery with a devoted pop-up following has found a sunny corner storefront, but the proposed lease makes the tenant responsible for more than flour, frosting, and a cheerful opening day.
matters.demo_prompt: Review this first-store lease scenario, identify the top negotiation points, and create a practical due-diligence checklist.
suggested_tasks: Create lease redline matrix and build-out contingency list
Request exclusivity, zoning, and utility documentation
Prepare opening-date and guaranty negotiation checklist

matters.name: Marigold Estate - Garden Shop Transition
matters.description: A beloved garden-shop owner left a handwritten note, a small greenhouse business, and three adult children who all agree the shop should survive but disagree about who should run it.
matters.demo_prompt: Organize this estate-and-business transition into immediate, near-term, and long-term decisions while flagging questions for local probate counsel.
suggested_tasks: Inventory estate and garden-shop records
Create 30-day business-continuity checklist
Prepare beneficiary communication and decision calendar

matters.name: Neighborly Fence - Garden and Dog-Run Mediation
matters.description: A charming community garden, an energetic rescue dog, and six inches of fence line have turned two friendly neighbors into people who no longer wave across the driveway.
matters.demo_prompt: Prepare a constructive mediation agenda, identify the information gaps, and outline settlement terms that let both neighbors enjoy their yards again.
suggested_tasks: Prepare neutral chronology and document exchange list
Draft mediation agenda, caucus questions, and settlement options
Create written-agreement checklist for work scope and access
